creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Closing the last pane left a window nobody could get out of: nothing on
screen, a title claiming it was `--renderer-check`, and ⌘T refused
("this window has no daemon its keyboard is on"). Reported from the real
app with a run log showing two refused create_tab requests.

Two defects, both fixed.

**Every request resolved its daemon from the focused region**
(`handler.rs::resolve_daemon`). No panes means no focused region means no
daemon, so ⌘T had nothing to ask - although the local daemon was attached
and healthy. `create_tab` now falls through to `CreateWorkspace` when
there is no pane to name a workspace off, which is what launch has always
done for a daemon that holds nothing (`session.rs::open_a_workspace_if_the_window_is_empty`).
Launch stops at the first *local* daemon because filling a window is
Muster's own idea and a remote machine is somebody else's; ⌘T falls back
to any attached daemon, because pressing the key is the invitation the
launch rule exists to wait for.

**The title lied.** `PaneAppearance.title` returned the renderer-check
string for any window with no keyboard pane. Three different windows have
no pane - the diagnostic mode, an attach that failed, and one whose panes
were all closed - and they want opposite reactions. The third now reads
`muster - no panes`, plus the daemon's health, since the likeliest reason
a window has no panes and nobody closed any is that the daemon went away.

And the window now says how to get out of it: two centred lines naming
the chord `new_tab` is actually bound to, or the menu item when somebody
unbound it. Shown after a quarter second, because a cold launch publishes
an empty view for the ~50ms it takes the daemon to answer with the
workspace Muster just asked for, and painting immediately flashed text on
the way up.

Covered by `crates/muster-seam/tests/attach.rs` (empties a real session
and refills it through the core; reproduces the exact refusal without the
fix), `EmptyWindowTests`, and `PaneChromeTests`. Eyeballed in the running
app: title read back as "muster - no panes" while empty and
"muster - w2:p1" once a workspace arrived.
title: 🕳️ A window with no panes is a window you can refill
